newsitem.title: USA: Renaissance Cosmetics gets financing commitment.
newsitem.headline: Renaissance Cosmetics gets financing commitment.

text.p: Renaissance Cosmetics Inc said it has received commitments to provide a $117.5 million senior secured debt financing with a one-year term.
The financing has an initial interest rate at 11.5 percent per year, the company said.
Proceeds will be used to refinance its existing bank credit facility and complete two previously announced acquisitions, Renaissance Cosmetics said.

The consummation of the financing is subject to the execution and delivery of definitive documentation and the satisfaction of other customary closing conditions and is expected to occur on or before December 21, 1996, the company said.
The transaction was structured by CIBC Wood Gundy Securities Corp, Renaissance Cosmetics said.

Also, Renaissance Cosmetics said it intends to buy all of its 13-3/4 percent senior notes due 2001 at a redemption price of $1,165 per $1,000 of principal during the first quarter of 1997. A majority of the note holders agreed to tender their notes, the company said.
